name: UTM (Built-in StikJIT)
subtitle: Virtual machines for iOS with Built-in StikJIT

apps.name: UTM (StikJIT)
apps.subtitle: Virtual machines for iOS with Built-in StikJIT
apps.localizedDescription: UTM is a full featured virtual machine host for iOS, patched with Built-in StikJIT (UTMJITHelper.appex + StikJIT.framework) so JIT can be enabled directly from UTM using LocalDevVPN and a pairing file, or via StikDebug / Wait for Debugger.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: UTM uses the local network to communicate with VMs and discover pairing services for Built-in StikJIT.

versions.localizedDescription: UTM with Built-in StikJIT (UTMJITHelper.appex + StikJIT.framework with 16-digit hex address patch).
